units.source_text: 今天早上不知什么时候，名人把理发师叫来，将头剃得光秃秃的，活像个和尚。

en.t: Sometime this morning, the Master called in a barber and had his head shaved completely bare, looking just like a monk.

units.source_text: 原先他把住院时留的长发梳了个分头，将白发染黑，才到伊东来。

en.t: Before coming to Ito, he had parted the long hair he had grown while in the hospital and dyed his white hair black.

units.source_text: 后来突然理成短平头，令人感到有点装模作样。

en.t: Later, when he suddenly had it cut into a short crew cut, it struck people as a little affected.

units.source_text: 不过，看上去仿佛洗净了什么东西，显得干净利落，光泽红润，返老还童了。

en.t: Still, he looked as though something had been washed clean from him, neat and brisk, with a healthy glow, as if he had grown young again.
